## Highlights
### New
- Choose a default page zoom that new and existing pages follow - Keep split views visible in collapsed folders and customize them with names, icons, emoji, and colors - Import, search, review, reveal, and delete passwords directly from each Space's settings - Use custom search engines with website icons and optional search suggestions in each Space - See update availability and control media from a global sidebar widget deck across Spaces
### Improved
- Follow new downloads into Downloads and see live size, progress, speed, and time remaining across Mac and iPhone
### Fixed
- Keep typing and cursor placement reliable in website editors on Mac - Show the Start Page on launch instead of a blank unloaded tab - Show blocked pop-ups in Site Controls with a one-step allow action - Keep loading pages on-brand, reuse an open Start Page, and search tabs only in the current Space
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
